To summarize, the conclusion of current research is showing that consuming 3mg/kg caffeine, 1.5 g Lcarnitine and their combination has no meaningful effect on performance More researches are necessary in order to investigate the acute effects of different amount of  caffeine and L-carnitine on freestyle   performance time and the   blood lactate level.

This research was supported by a grant from Karaj Branch, Islamic Azad University. The authors would like to thank Dr mehdi hedayati for his technical assistance.
